Umar Khalid's prolonged pre-trial detention and isolation highlighted

Activist Umar Khalid has reportedly expressed feelings of isolation after spending nearly six years in jail without a trial. This situation raises questions about judicial accountability and the application of laws like the UAPA. The extended pre-trial detention of individuals has become a point of concern.
